This page contains manuscripts and research work available prior to, or alongside, formal publication.

For long-term scholarly preservation, preprints may also be deposited in an institutional repository or a research repository such as Zenodo, with this page serving as the central index.

## Current preprints

**Hafida Abbas, Abdelhalim Azzouz.**  
“A nonlocal transmission problem on a hybrid continuous-discrete domain.” arXiv:2603.14178 (March 2026).  
A quadratic nonlocal variational problem on a domain made of a compact interval and finitely many discrete points: existence and uniqueness of a minimizer, and its characterization as the weak solution of a hybrid Euler–Lagrange system.  
[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14178){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm} [PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.14178){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm}

**Abdelhalim Azzouz, Praveen Agarwal, Delfim F. M. Torres, Hafida Abbas.**  
“Towards a Gagliardo-Type Theory of Fractional Sobolev Spaces on Arbitrary Time Scales.” arXiv:2603.14715 (March 2026).  
A Gagliardo-type construction of fractional Sobolev spaces on arbitrary time scales, with completeness, reflexivity and Hilbert structure, a comparison with derivative-based definitions, and Poincaré-type inequalities and embeddings on bounded hybrid time scales.  
[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14715){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm} [PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.14715){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm}

**Hafida Abbas, Abdelhalim Azzouz, Mohammed Brahim Zahaf, Mohamed Belmekki.**  
“Generalized Extended Riemann-Liouville type fractional derivative operator.” arXiv:1912.03464 (December 2019).  
Extensions of the incomplete gamma, beta and hypergeometric functions through the extended Bessel function, with recurrence relations, transformation formulas, Mellin transforms, and an extension of the Riemann–Liouville fractional derivative.  
[arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/1912.03464){.btn .btn-outline-primary .btn-sm} [PDF](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.03464){.btn .btn-outline-secondary .btn-sm}
